acceptance_criteria.description: Atomic submit: validation, dedup, unknown/self/cycle rejection, idempotent spec match, zero writes on invalid batch, detached 12-key views, get/list sorted.
Claim/recover/complete/fail state machine: eligibility, priority+lexicographic order, lease math, bounded retries, stale/terminal rejection, no write on ValueError.
Cross-process safety: BEGIN IMMEDIATE claim+recover atomicity, no double active lease, durability across reopen/fresh process.
Strict CLI: op/field whitelist, sorted-keys single newline exit 0, exit 2 empty stdout on all error paths, per-invocation commit.
Local regression suite passes via full unittest discover covering contract matrix plus multiprocess exclusivity and rollback.

assumptions: Python 3.12 stdlib sqlite3 only, manual integer now >=0, tempdir DBs.
Preserve Queue and python -m durable_queue entry points; no network/daemon/packages/UI.
Invalid requests raise ValueError with zero writes including no implicit recovery.
discoveries: submit uses INSERT OR REPLACE destroying existing jobs, no validation/atomicity/cycles/idempotency.
claim/recover/complete/fail unimplemented; storage single jobs(id,data) table, timeout 5, no WAL or txn control.
CLI pops op, direct dispatch, leaks tracebacks, no sorted-keys/newline/exit-2/field-whitelist handling.
goal: Complete durable_queue package and JSON CLI per CONTRACT.md with atomicity, leases, retries, rollback and multiprocess regression tests.
risks: Batch partially writes without BEGIN IMMEDIATE; invalid batch must roll back including recovery.
Concurrent claim double-grants lease without exclusive txn and single-statement claim.
Stale worker completes/fails after expiry or reclaim; require worker+attempt match and now<lease_until, terminal immutable.
Unready jobs claimed when dependencies merely exist; require all succeeded, failed blocks without propagation.
Bool accepted as int, non-finite JSON, wrong view keys/order, wrong ready_at rules break contract checks.

steps.instructions: Harden storage.py: WAL mode, busy timeout, BEGIN IMMEDIATE txn helper, stable schema preserving jobs, shared strict validators (bool!=int, finite JSON, nonempty id/worker).
steps.title: Storage transactions and validators

steps.instructions: Implement atomic submit/get/list: normalize defaults, reject unknown fields, no caller mutation, intra-batch dup, unknown/self/cycle check, idempotent original-spec store, detached 12-key views, ID-sorted list.
steps.title: Atomic submit and views

steps.instructions: Implement claim(+implicit recover)/recover/complete/fail in one exclusive txn: eligibility, priority+lexicographic pick, lease math, ready_at rules, stale/terminal checks, no write on error.
steps.title: Atomic leases and transitions

steps.instructions: Rewrite CLI with op/signature whitelist, sorted-keys newline exit0, exit2 empty-stdout on error, fresh-process commit; add local-only tests: multiprocess claim exclusivity, CLI durability, rollback, expiry/retry/stale matrix.
steps.title: Strict CLI and regression tests

verification_strategy.description: V1 contract matrix: run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v for validation, ordering, leases, retries, stale rejection.
V2 multiprocess safety: run python3.12 -m unittest tests.test_regression -v for subprocess claim exclusivity and fresh-process durability.
V3 CLI and rollback: run python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -v plus CLI exit-2, sorted-keys newline, invalid-batch zero-write checks.
